    // # NoiseTexture
    //
    // Grey-scale fractal Brownian motion, evaluated in UV space with the noise

    // range and written to all three channels at full opacity.

    // The fBm value at a UV coordinate, in [-1, 1].
    NoiseValue(self: NoiseTexture, uv: UvCoordinate): Number
